description: The exporter can publish a normalized tensor name that does not exist in the unchanged shard header.
trigger: A scanned shard contains multi_modal_projector.mm_input_projection_weight, and export proceeds with multiple shards or --force.
expected_behavior: An index intended to identify stored tensors should preserve the name present in the referenced shard.
actual_behavior: read_header renames that key to multi_modal_projector.mm_input_projection.weight in memory; main exports the renamed key without rewriting the shard. A consumer requiring exact stored names would not find it. No external consumer failure was executed.

verification.description: Traced normalization through collection construction into the new exporter. Whole-parent search found no existing references to add_safetensors_index; the task supplies its direct CLI call to main. The observation applies to exports containing the alias, not every model or existing loading workflow.
verification.limits: External reader behavior was not executed.

verification.description: Modeled the inspected rename and checked that the exported name is absent from a synthetic raw header.
verification.limits: Synthetic dictionary check, not a real checkpoint or loader run.

introductions.rationale: 254 introduces the exporter using the normalized collection keys, while the underlying shard keeps its original tensor names.
